name: Item Move Test
author: S.A.M Framework
description: An unattended test of gear on allies (sam_monster_get_inventory, sam_monster_can_equip, sam_monster_equip_item, sam_monster_unequip_to_inventory, sam_give_item_to_ally, sam_take_item_from_ally): makes a human and a kobold follow player 0, hands items over, dresses and undresses them, vetoes one equip from a handler, and checks that the same item (the same uid) is what moved. Run it with tools/run_mod_test.sh ItemMoveTest.
